title: Approximation by simple structures
summary: In her graduate thesis, Gwyneth Harrison-Shermoen developed an abstract framework for approximating structures of a given theory, which generalized the notion of smoothly approximable structures. At the time it was unclear how broadly the framework applied due to a lack of examples. In this paper we will show that with slight modification to the framework, several well-understood $\mathrm{NSOP}_1$ theories are in fact approximable by simple structures.
